softwareInnerHero.title: Microsoft 365 Business
paragraphs: Microsoft 365 Business (encompassing plans like Business Basic, Standard, and Premium) is an integrated suite of productivity apps and cloud services specifically tailored for small to medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Beyond just the familiar Office applications, it combines best-in-class productivity tools with intelligent cloud services, sophisticated security features, and simplified device management, enabling businesses to thrive in a modern, collaborative, and secure environment.
